title: SSP-2.5 — Project State Document Tracing Evidence
summary: record the versioned all-subject document placement, provenance-aware Series projection and live 3 symbols verification
content_html:
SSP-2.5 — Project State Document Tracing Evidence

Outcome

SSP-2.5 is complete at its review checkpoint. Project State now emits docs_project_state_report_v2 and docs_project_state_folder_lookup_v2. The immediate projects/ directory scan remains the only Folder-row authority. The producer retains every exact valid Project document subject, then places Folder subjects by exact scanned key, Work subjects through the canonical Work's first-level project_folder, and Series subjects into each distinct scanned Folder containing a current member Work.

Subsequent decision: the v2 document-tracing and browser evidence remains accepted. Resolver Tokens were retired before implementation, so SSP-2.6 removes only the now-unused lookup product and its dedicated machinery before SSP-2 recloses.

Each placed report document retains its exact Docs Viewer target and presentation, unchanged declared_subject, and ordered applicable_series_ids. The matching lookup retains exact target and placement provenance without copying document or catalogue presentation into a second authority. A document is deduplicated once per Folder even when several Series member Works establish that placement. matched_document_count counts distinct placed documents; document_placement_count counts their total Folder appearances; unmatched_document_count records valid subject documents with no current scanned placement.

Browser Projection

Folder view continues to show one physical Folder row with each placed document once. Series view now filters documents through producer-supplied provenance: a Series-subject document appears only under its exact Series, a Work-subject document appears under each current Series membership of that Work in the Folder, and a Folder-subject document appears with every current Series in the Folder. Any placed document without a current Series route remains visible in one blank-Series row.

Search, sorting, Copy table, and Copy Markdown consume the same visible projection. The focused browser fixture proves a Folder-wide document appears in two Series rows, one Series-subject document appears only in its exact Series row, and one Work-subject document with no current Series route appears only in the blank-Series row. Series-specific search and Markdown serialization retain only the documents belonging to the matched visible row.

Focused Evidence

  • Thirteen focused producer, versioned schema, lookup publication, stale-retention, report registry/service, and public-isolation tests pass.
  • The producer fixture covers two member Works establishing one Series placement in a Folder, one Series spanning two scanned Folders, a Work in two Series, Work and Series subjects, recorded-only and otherwise unplaceable subjects, distinct document and placement counts, generation changes, and a Work with no Series route.
  • The Docs Viewer router-module smoke passes the v2 response boundary, provenance-aware Folder/Series projections, blank-Series retention, Series-specific visible search, deterministic sorting, TSV, the exact GMT Markdown preamble, per-row Markdown links, automatic mount, explicit refresh, and current-run failure handling.
  • Explicit Python compilation, focused Python lint, focused JavaScript lint, and git diff --check pass.

Live Evidence

A read-only live producer run returned docs_project_state_report_v2. The 3 symbols document d-20260801-212422-df11f3 retained the declared subject {kind: "series", key: "005"} and applicable_series_ids: ["005"]. The scanned Folder set related to current Series 005 Works was exactly projects/3 symbols; the document's placed Folder set was also exactly projects/3 symbols. It therefore appears once in Folder view and only under Series 005 in Series view.

The same live run counted 231 distinct placed documents and 231 Folder placements. These values are a current verification snapshot rather than schema limits.

Review Boundary

The implementation changes one existing producer, one existing browser report module, and their focused tests. It adds no report route, service, persisted presentation snapshot, mutation hook, folder watcher, public Project State product, recursive scan, generic relationship store, or Resolver Token behavior. project_subfolder, media filenames, publication state, and catalogue presentation retain their existing owners.

SSP-2 remains in-progress after this accepted checkpoint because SSP-2.6 must remove the now-unused v2 lookup before reclose. SSP-3 no longer consumes Project State.
